outputs.explanation: The spatial plots are heatmap-style overlays on tissue micrographs showing deconvolution scores per spot; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.

This is a box plot showing distribution of fraction-of-cells values across biological replicates; box/violin plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement (and individual points are in fact also overlaid here).
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots; overlaying individual data points on a running enrichment score line plot is not applicable and this plot type is exempt.

This is a bar graph showing log2 fold change (an aggregate/summary statistic) for each gene without any overlaid individual data points; bar charts of averaged/aggregated values require individual data points unless exempt, and this does not fall into an exempt category (box/violin/heatmap/line/pie/scatter).
Panel E consists of representative H&E and IHC micrographs/photomicrographs, not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
